children: There seems to be a fair case for the rupee to appreciate from current levels, India's central bank Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said on Wednesday.
Rupee depreciation over the last year-and-a-half was a temporary phenomenon, and the current account deficit would continue to shrink as dependency on oil reduces, Gupta said at an event in Mumbai.
